decision: FONT = Cormorant Garamond wght 500;600;700 (Google Fonts vietnamese subset; Cinzel rejected - no VN support) via existing index.html link, no new dependency; English names live in cards.ts as data source of truth (nameEn field), NOT derived runtime from cardImages - drift caught by cross-test; gold accents only --color-gold #d4af37 + --color-gold-soft #e9cf8f for borders/badges/headings, palette not repainted; prose readings keep Vietnamese card names

UX interaction baseline (cursor/smooth/mystical): (1) global cursor rules in src/index.css @layer base - pointer for button:not(:disabled)/a/[role=button]/select/summary/label[for], not-allowed for disabled (root cause: Tailwind v4 preflight dropped default button pointer, verified in dist CSS); (2) CardFan scroller gets cursor-grab + active:cursor-grabbing as PURE CSS pseudo-class, no React state re-render; (3) @media prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables .star/starGlow/flyOut animations and scroll-behavior smooth; plus :focus-visible gold ring for keyboard a11y; (4) NEW CursorGlow component (~40 lines): ONE fixed div, radial gold gradient, rAF lerp follow, transform-only compositing, mounted once in App.tsx; runs ONLY if window.matchMedia exists AND (pointer:fine) matches AND reduced-motion NOT set -> touch devices and jsdom get nothing rendered/animated; no dependency added; (5) StarField hoisted from HomePage to App-level wrapper "fixed inset-0 -z-10" (negative z-index paints above root background but below content) so every page gets star ambience; remove HomePage local instance to avoid double render; (6) card hover glow is HOVER-SCOPED only (transition box-shadow/opacity <= 300ms); FORBIDDEN to add new infinite animations on many-node lists (existing debt: starGlow on ~78 hidden backfaces of AllCardsPage)

CSS Cascade Layers rule for this repo: overrides targeting unlayered rules (.star/.flip-inner/.fly-out/.card-back/html scroll-behavior) MUST live unlayered at END of index.css, never inside @layer base - layered normal declarations always lose to unlayered ones regardless of specificity or source order (MDN @layer). Exception kept by design: cursor baseline + focus-visible STAY in @layer base because they must lose to Tailwind utilities (disabled:cursor-not-allowed / active:cursor-grabbing). Verification lesson: "marker exists in dist CSS" does NOT prove an override wins cascade - must compare byte offsets/order against every conflicting rule on the built artifact
